meta.name: higgsfield-product-photoshoot
meta.description:
Generate brand-quality product images through Higgsfield product-photoshoot
prompt enhancement on GPT Image 2 / gpt_image_2. Entry point for professional
brand/product visuals.
Use when: "product photo", "studio shot", "lifestyle image", "Pinterest pin",
"hero/banner", "carousel", "ad creative", "Meta ads", "virtual try-on",
"model wearing", "person holding product", "closeup with hands",
"levitating/floating/splash product", "CGI/surreal product", "restyle",
"seasonal/aesthetic variation", or any product, brand, or paid-social creative.
Modes: product_shot, lifestyle_scene, closeup_product_with_person,
moodboard_pin, hero_banner, social_carousel, ad_creative_pack,
virtual_model_tryout, conceptual_product, restyle. Backend assembles the final
prompt; never freehand it.
NOT for: no-product text-to-image (use higgsfield-generate), branded avatar
video (use higgsfield-generate Marketing Studio), marketplace listing cards
(use higgsfield-marketplace-cards), Soul Character training (use
higgsfield-soul-id).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成品牌级产品图片，用于广告和社交媒体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为品牌或电商生成高质量产品视觉素材
copy.tagline_en: Generate brand-quality product images for ads and social media
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need high-quality product visuals for your brand or ecommerce

howto.what: 装好后,当你要求做产品图或品牌视觉时,Claude会先简短问几个问题(风格、用途等),挑一个对应模式,然后调用Higgsfield的工具在GPT Image 2上生成图片,最后只把图片链接发给你。生成提示词由后台拼接,Claude不自己写。
howto.when: 当你说出“product photo”“studio shot”“lifestyle image”等关键词,或要求做横幅、广告素材、虚拟试穿等产品/品牌视觉时触发;不处理无产品的纯文生图等任务。

say.text: 给我的咖啡瓶做一张生活场景图,要阳光厨房的感觉
把这张产品图改成圣诞节的安静奢华风格
say.note: Claude会用restyle模式保留主体只换氛围。

say.text: 生成3张不同背景的产品图,白底和木质桌面各一张
say.note: Claude会用product_shot模式并生成3个变体。

howto.what_en: After install, when you request product/brand visuals, Claude asks a few short questions, picks a mode, runs the Higgsfield product-photoshoot command on gpt_image_2, and returns only image URLs. The backend builds the prompt; Claude never writes it.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'product photo', 'studio shot', 'lifestyle image', or requests for banners, ad creatives, virtual try-ons, etc. Not for text-to-image without a product.

say_en.text: Create a lifestyle scene for my coffee bottle with a sunny kitchen vibe.
say_en.note: Claude selects lifestyle_scene and returns image URLs.

say_en.text: Restyle this product photo into a Christmas, quiet-luxury version.
say_en.note: Claude uses restyle mode, keeping the subject.

say_en.text: Generate 3 product shots with different backgrounds, white and wood.
say_en.note: Claude uses product_shot mode and returns 3 variants.
